steers.detail: Trigger hit: BTC 80565 crossed above 80564. Executing long 11.10 USDT 5x, SL 80240, TP 81400. CEO add tranche 2026-10-24 18:55 UTC: '80500 long, $11 HL minimum' — §12 mapping upper break 80500 = LONG (CEO level). Adds to pipeline long #16382 (continuum+, ATR-managed — separate tranche per §7; this leg carries the manual exit stack: BE-lock 0.10% + MANUAL_TRAIL_TIERS 0.50/0.70/1.00/1.40). Trigger 80564 = 64pt cushion above 80500, clears the bounce highs 80416-80419. SL 80240: 324pt below trigger / 260 below the level — under the 80252 15m structure, dies if the reclaim fails back (200pt+ wick room). TP 81400: into 81240-81400 supply before the 81500 shelf. R:R planned 2.58 / real 1.21 (200pt slip). RULE-10 DISCLOSURE: TP 836pts ~1.7x 1h ATR — deep target approved as CEILING; BE-lock + tiered trail do the exit work; fires only on fresh breakout momentum (#16351 class). MERGE CAVEAT (§11-7): if #16382 is still open at fire time, HL merges same-coin longs — first level hit closes ALL; #16382's TP 80853 would then govern (+~1.8% margin on this tranche), not 81400. Engine executes with --force (CEO tranche, one-shot state). PRECHECK (advisory): FAIL — LOSERS, coin_shame, 15m RSI 80 overbought at arm time (reported, standing rule). Chop 6 flips — 5x. Non-conflict: TP 81400 < armed long trigger 81564 (sequential, fine).

   profit-monster-trail 38 trades 33W +2.27 | atr_sl_hit 29 trades 0W -1.63 |
   hard_max_loss 14 trades 0W -1.79 | trail_arm_timeout 9 3W -0.23 |
   hard_sl 6 0W -0.56 | stale_exit 3 0W -0.64. Pre-trail/stop family = 61
   trades, 3W, -4.85; trail/tp family = 51 trades, 41W, +3.67.
   WINNING SIDE: entries that trended immediately so the trail could work.
   WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: 0 of the 43 atr_sl/hard_max_loss/hard_sl trades ever
   got far enough to arm — they were filled mid-chop on absent volume. Same
   condition live right now (volume_ratio median 0.04), which is why the
   no-new-entries steer above is warning-level, not info.

2) By direction, 7d (re-run): LONG n=70 29W -1.44 | SHORT n=33 16W +0.88.
   The paying side all week was SHORT. Today's breadth (85:7 long) has not
   yet repaid the week's longs — both facts stand. Our 2 open trades entered
   SHORT-side RSI conditions on the long side (meta_rsi 27.48 / 26.79), i.e.
   we bought dips rather than chasing, which is the reconciling detail.

3) Oversold-short check on last 20 closes (BANANA discipline, re-run and
   REPRODUCED exactly): 11 shorts with meta_rsi<45 -> 7W 4L, net +0.29
   (wins #16381 BTC +0.04, CFX +0.34, DYDX +0.16, MON +0.12, LTC +0.09,
   ICP +0.04, SYRUP +0.04; losses ALT -0.17, CC -0.15, ME -0.11, ZRO -0.11).
   Oversold shorts are NOT a loss pattern this window -> NO wrong-side steer.
   The 4 losers vs 7 winners share the same RSI band and direction; the
   discriminator was SPEED — winners resolved in 9-14 min via
   profit-monster-trail, losers ground 23-47 min and exited
   hard_max_loss/stale_exit/cut-loser. Same conclusion as (1), different cut.

4) 14d signal families bleeding (signal_performance, n=326, -3.44):
   ai-trader+ n=24 29.2% -1.05 (OFF per CEO 2026-10-19), bb-bounce-v2-long+
   n=34 44.1% -0.94, doji-bottom-long n=20 40.0% -0.62, pump-chain+ n=45
   26.7% -0.48, pump-chain- n=35 22.9% -0.30.
   WINNING SIDE in that group = not taking those longs / taking the fades.
   Counter-evidence for balance: 7d volume-buildup- n=14 57% +0.20,
   continuum-trend+ n=5 80% +0.09, bb-squeeze+ n=5 60% +0.30, pump-chain-
   n=9 33% +0.31. Not everything is broken; the bleed is concentrated.
